nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Rare Earth Pore-Minimizing Clay Mask

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin say the mask controls shine and reduces oiliness in the T-zone without over-drying, though one reviewer with an oily-leaning skin type still calls it 'a tad bit drying.'
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are split: several report real dryness, dry patches, tightness, or the need to double up on moisturizer afterward, while a larger number, including some who specifically feared clay masks would over-dry them, say it left their dry skin soft and unstripped, particularly when used only about once a week.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe applying the mask only where needed, such as the T-zone, and say it leaves skin soft and plump without a tight or stripped feeling, even with regular use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no burning, stinging, or redness, several calling it the first clay mask that hasn't irritated them unlike others they've tried, although a couple describe tingling, burning, or temporary redness on application or removal.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who describes her skin as mature and postmenopausal says the mask was not overly drying, and a 44-year-old reviewer who listed fine lines among her concerns reported a visible improvement in skin texture after targeted use.

concerns.aging: The single reviewer who names fine lines as one of her skin concerns, a 44-year-old, used the mask on her cheeks, nose, and fine-line areas and reported a noticeable improvement in texture, though this is the only review in the set that addresses aging directly.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including many with dry skin, describe the mask as surprisingly non-stripping or even hydrating for a clay mask, with several saying it didn't over-dry them despite expecting it to. A smaller number disagree, reporting real dryness, dry patches, or a tight, stripped feeling, sometimes bad enough to require doubling up on moisturizer afterward.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers say the mask calms existing redness, including one who reports it eases her rosacea and another whose usual facial redness 'is gone down completely'; sensitive-skin reviewers in particular note it caused no redness where other clay masks have. A few dissent, describing tingling, burning, or visible redness for a few minutes right after application or removal.
concerns.spots: Reviewers who mention blackheads, especially around the nose and T-zone, consistently say the mask visibly reduces their appearance with regular, typically weekly, use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin generally report the mask helps, including as a spot treatment for hormonal or cystic breakouts, without triggering new blemishes for most users. Two reviewers dissent with a specific warning, saying the mask can cause the skin to 'purge,' bringing on a temporary breakout that clears up within a day.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin say the mask reduces shine and leaves the T-zone feeling less greasy, with one noting it worked even better on her husband's oilier skin than on her own.

aspects.libelle: Mild tingling or tightness while drying
Small amount needed, jar lasts long
Jar requires dipping in with fingers

extraits.titre: Too drying for me, better for oily skin
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product did not work for me. It caused dry patches on the areas where I used it. This may be due to my skin being much more dry than usual due to the extremely cold dry weather we are experiencing at the moment. I will definitely try it in the spring and summer when it has a better chance of working for me. It was very smooth to put on. A little goes a long way so this jar would last you forever. If you already have more oily skin as a baseline this may work better for you off the bat than it did for me.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was looking forward to testing this face mask for myself because I've heard good things. I have combo to sensitive skin I live in a dry cold climate so I only apply the mask where it's needed. Really enjoy the texture it applied very easily and stays put. I think this is nice because it doesn't feel like it's stripping my skin, while performing like it should. I try not to over use it because I want to keep my skin balanced and I think this helps with that. I agree the formula is soothing and even if I needed to use it more often I am confident it wouldn't completely damage my skin barrier. While the Amazonian Clay does draw out the impurities from my clogged pores. I know this is a more pricey product but I do believe the size of this jar will get you through your challenging times in a pinch.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Age: 44, Primary skin concerns: Dryness, Redness, Texture, Fine Lines, Occasional blackheads and breakouts, Large sebaceous filament openings Using mask to target: Texture on cheeks, sebaceous filament openings, fine lines (elevens, parentheses) Opinion: Scent: None. This is unscented. If scented skincare bothers you, this won't. Apperance: Light gray, appropriate for a clay mask, but because you have to stick your hand in the tub, kind of messy. I should have used a mask brush, and this could be in a tube. Texture: Squishy, soft, that does adhere but is not sticky (I HAAAATE sticky). It was easy to wipe off my hand. Ingredients: Surprisingly basic. Everything at more than 1% (everything above phenoxyethanol) is either moisturizing or clay (and some titanium dioxide for color). I'm REALLY surprised by how simple this formulation actually is because... Effectiveness: It's surprisingly effective. I wouldn't use it every week, but it really does make a noticeable difference in the texture on my nose and cheeks. I'd absolutely use this before special event makeup for a smoother canvas. NOTE: Other products shown in "after" photo: Murad Multi-Vitamin Infusion Oil (Like I said, I'm dry. Can't do tight, clean skin without something.)

extraits.titre: Simple clay mask that actually works
extraits.texte: I have a super acne prone skin, and it tends to get oily and greasy often. I tried this mask out very recently and since then it has become my go to when my skin feels kinda gross or oily. I use it about once or twice a week, put it on, let it sit, and my skin just feels way cleaner and calmer after. It rinses off easily too and doesn't leave any residue behind. Also, it doesn't sting or dry me out at all, which is nice. Pores on my cheek look less noticeable and my skin feels much smoother. Plus, it helps calm the redness around my nose as well. Overall, good value for money, decent packaging and most importantly it just does the job really well!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The first mask I've tried in a very long time that didn't irritate my skin or cause a burning sensation. I've tried other clay masks and they always cause redness. This one didn't! It's very thick, as you can see in the video I uploaded but really you only need a thin layer and small amount of product to cover your whole face. I can see this jar lasting a long time. It dries fast and is easy to remove with a washcloth or even with just warm water. My skin didn't feel dry and stretched out either. It felt moisturized even before applying my moisturizer! I haven't noticed any difference in the size of my pores though but my skin did feel very refreshed, clean and soft so I can only expect good things to come of using this product. My skin loved it.

I have dry skin that isn't particularly sensitive, but I am acne-prone and struggle with blackheads, especially around my nose, T-zone, and chin. I was pleasantly surprised by how effective this mask is without feeling harsh or over-irritating. It draws out impurities and visibly clears blackheads, leaving my pores looking cleaner and more refined. It rinses off easily with no residue and has little to no scent, just a subtle natural clay smell. While it feels slightly tightening as it dries, following up with a good moisturizer leaves my skin feeling balanced rather than stripped. The sturdy, high-quality packaging makes it easy to use, and with weekly use, my pores look noticeably clearer.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Such a treat for your skin! It did well getting rid of my blackheads. It did make my skin purge a bit so be prepared to deal with that. However, after the breakouts, my skin looked so smooth. As for application, it applies well as a thin layer and easily builds up. Remember to only leave it on for the specified time to not dry out your skin. It also washes off well without much residue.
